CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinate set) is identified and presented as an organized pattern, and a separate origin/status field is provided for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is related to identified content presentation or access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names content referents with color attributes and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata (e.g. copied_prior_record) is provided separately from the content coordinates, distinguishing identification from status/source.

O.rationale: Content is presented as organized coordinate sets (peaks) for the named referent, indicating presentation/organization.
